limitations: Producer runtime evidence is not an independent semantic judgment. TypeSafe/Jev verification of retained media is a prerequisite; no model/API call was made.

Return to labs 02–18 uses the existing public __pixelQuestDebug.enterRegion input after reload because progress is session-bound; duels and evidence are produced through visible native controls. No completeEncounter/auto-pass hook is used.
This observation covers local HTTP Chromium at 1280×800, not deployment, all browsers, or mobile usability.
